product: Acne tracking app that scans your skin every week, scores it, finds the likely cause and builds a routine

banned_topics: negative framing of a named brand or person
rules.tone: A young woman telling what she changed, in order, in her own words; specific and unpolished, never a claim about results for anyone else.

guidance.hook_style: A moment in time (a date line, a day something happened) or small habits that hold your skin back. First person.
angles: a story in order: the day it got bad, what she changed (food, routine, sleep), the app once, the after
small habits that hold your skin back (touching your face, sleeping late, skipping water, changing products weekly)
what a weekly scan showed her
notes: ClearLog appears once: what the scan showed or what the routine builder did
no invented scores or percentages on the slides
the closer is the after, one or two lines

app_store.title: ClearLog: Skin Tracker
app_store.subtitle: Weekly scans, a routine that fits
